project.name: Floral Boutique E-Commerce Website
project.summary: An elegant, highly interactive single-page web application for a boutique flower shop, showcasing floral arrangements, offering bouquet customization, and providing a seamless ordering experience.

tasks.focus: Establish the visual identity, elegant typography, boutique-themed color schemes, product card layouts, and overall aesthetic direction suitable for a high-end flower shop.
Design the single-page application structure, state management for the shopping cart, responsive layout system, and component modularity for optimal performance.
Define interactive features including catalog filtering (by occasion, flower type, price), custom bouquet builder, shopping cart operations, and a simulated delivery checkout flow.

design.theme: Elegant Botanical Premium - A romantic, sophisticated, and organic aesthetic inspired by luxury floral design, using soft editorial layouts, warm natural tones, and delicate animations to evoke sensory delight.

typography.font_family: Playfair Display (Serif) for headings to establish luxury/editorial tone, paired with Inter or Montserrat (Sans-serif) for clean, readable body copy.
typography.scale: H1: 3.25rem (52px) / Line-height: 1.2; H2: 2.25rem (36px) / Line-height: 1.3; H3: 1.5rem (24px) / Line-height: 1.4; Body: 1rem (16px) / Line-height: 1.6; Small/Muted: 0.875rem (14px) / Line-height: 1.5

layout: Header: Sticky, transparent background transitioning to a frosted glass effect (backdrop-filter: blur(12px), white background at 85% opacity) on scroll. Centered serif logo with delicate navigation links on the left and utility icons (search, profile, elegant interactive cart drawer) on the right.

Hero Section: Immersive split-screen layout. Left side features high-impact editorial typography, a poetic value proposition, and a prominent call-to-action button. Right side features a high-definition, organically-masked image of a signature bouquet with floating petal micro-elements.

Product & Customizer Grid: A dynamic 3-column grid for featured arrangements with soft transitions. Below, an interactive 'Bouquet Builder' workspace featuring a split-pane layout: a visual interactive canvas on the left showing the real-time bouquet assembly, and a step-by-step selection panel (vessel, focal flowers, foliage, wrap) on the right.

Footer: A minimal, elegant 4-column layout in deep botanical green background (#1E2B24) with warm gold accents. Includes an integrated newsletter signup with a thin gold border, social links with organic hover effects, store hours, and location details.
responsive_behavior: Desktop (1200px+): Generous whitespace (96px padding), multi-column grids, hover-activated detail states, and side-by-side presentation for the bouquet builder canvas.
Tablet (768px - 1023px): Two-column card grid, collapsible filter menus, side-swipeable product carousels, and optimized touch targets (minimum 48px) for interactive elements.

Mobile (under 768px): Single-column scroll, sticky bottom-anchored 'Add to Cart / Customize' action bar, full-screen overlay for navigation, and a vertical stacked step-by-step wizard for the bouquet customizer.
visual_style: Cards, Borders & Shadows: Clean cards with soft 12px border-radius, ultra-thin 1px borders in soft champagne gold (#C5A059) or sage green, and extremely soft, diffused shadows (0 12px 40px rgba(30, 43, 36, 0.04)) to create a weightless, floating feel.

Buttons & Inputs: Primary buttons are fully rounded pill shapes with a solid primary rose (#8D2B42) background, transitioning to a warm gold (#C5A059) on hover. Input fields use elegant bottom-only borders that expand on focus with a subtle glow.
animations: Micro-interactions: Hovering over floral arrangement cards triggers a smooth, slow image scale (1.04x) and gently fades in a 'Quick View' button. Selected items in the customizer float slightly upward with a subtle bounce.

Transitions & Page Motion: Page transitions utilize a gentle fade-in-up animation (0.5s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)). Adding flowers to the customizer canvas triggers a delicate particle effect resembling falling petals.

dom_structure: div#app-root - Root container wrapping the entire application layout.
header#app-header - Semantic header containing brand logo, main navigation, search bar (#search-input), and cart toggle button (#cart-toggle-btn) with a badge (#cart-badge-count).
main#app-main - Main content area containing dynamic sections managed by state routing.
section#hero-section - Visual introduction to the boutique with a call-to-action button to jump to catalog.
section#catalog-section - Catalog container containing filter sidebar/toolbar (#catalog-filters) and the dynamic grid container (#catalog-grid) for flower arrangement cards.

section#customizer-section - Interactive customizer panel including a live visual preview canvas/container (#customizer-preview) and a configuration form (#customizer-form) for selecting stems, wrapping, and ribbons.
aside#cart-drawer - Slide-out sidebar container for managing cart items, displaying item list (#cart-items-list), total price (#cart-total), and checkout CTA.
div#checkout-modal - Accessible modal dialog containing delivery form (#checkout-form), greeting card customizer, and simulated payment submission.
footer#app-footer - Semantic footer containing contact details, operating hours, and social links.

css_architecture.layout_strategy: CSS Grid for the main product catalog layout and customizer workspace. CSS Flexbox for header navigation, cart items list, and form control groups. Absolute/Fixed positioning for the slide-out cart drawer and centered checkout modal overlay.
responsive_breakpoints: Mobile: @media (max-width: 640px) - Single column catalog, hidden sidebar filters (collapsible), full-screen modal overlays.
Tablet: @media (max-width: 1024px) - Two-column catalog grid, flexible customizer layout.
Desktop: @media (min-width: 1025px) - Three to four-column catalog grid, persistent catalog filters, split-screen customizer (preview left, controls right).

core_functions: init() - Bootstraps application, loads product data, restores cart from localStorage, attaches global event listeners, and triggers initial render.
render() - Core orchestrator function that updates the DOM nodes (catalog, cart, customizer, UI states) based on the current state object.
renderCatalog() - Filters and sorts products state, then generates and injects card markup into #catalog-grid.
renderCart() - Generates markup for items in the cart, updates badge counts, calculates subtotals, and updates the cart drawer UI.
renderCustomizer() - Updates the customizer UI preview canvas and dynamically calculates custom bouquet prices based on chosen stems and materials.
addToCart(productId, quantity, isCustom, customDetails) - Adds item to state.cart, saves to localStorage, and opens the cart drawer.
updateCartQuantity(cartItemId, delta) - Modifies item quantities in state.cart, handles removal if quantity reaches zero.
setFilter(filterKey, value) - Updates state.filters and triggers renderCatalog().
submitOrder(formData) - Validates checkout form, triggers success animation, clears cart, and resets UI.
event_delegation: document.addEventListener('click', event) - Captures clicks on add-to-cart buttons, cart quantity controls, customizer selection chips, and modal close backdrops.
document.addEventListener('input', event) - Captures search query keyups, customizer range inputs, and checkout form validation.
document.addEventListener('submit', event) - Intercepts checkout form submission and customizer add-to-cart form.

constraints: All HTML, CSS, and JavaScript must reside within a single, self-contained index.html file.
Zero external build steps, bundlers, compilers, or package managers are allowed.
Semantic HTML5 markup must be used throughout (e.g., <header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <aside>, <footer>) with appropriate ARIA roles and keyboard focus states for modals and drawers.
External assets (images/icons) should use reliable royalty-free CDN URLs or inline SVGs to ensure visual richness without external file dependencies.
Client-side state persistence must be handled gracefully using localStorage.

features.name: Floral Catalog and Filtering System
features.purpose: Allows users to explore pre-designed floral arrangements, filter them by occasion or flower type, and search for specific bouquets.
features.interaction: User types in the search input, clicks on occasion category pills (e.g., 'Romance', 'Sympathy', 'Birthday'), or sorts by price (low-to-high, high-to-low).
features.behavior: Updates the filtered product list in the application state. The DOM dynamically re-renders the arrangement cards matching the search query and selected filters with smooth transition effects.
edge_cases: Empty search results: Displays a friendly message 'No floral arrangements match your search' with a 'Reset Filters' button.
Clearing the search input instantly restores the full catalog list.

features.name: Interactive Custom Bouquet Builder
features.purpose: Provides an engaging, step-by-step interactive experience for users to design their own bespoke bouquet.
features.interaction: User selects a base size (Small, Medium, Large), clicks plus/minus buttons to add specific flowers (e.g., Roses, Peonies, Eucalyptus), selects a wrapping style, and chooses a ribbon color.
features.behavior: Updates the custom bouquet state in real-time, calculating and displaying the dynamic price based on selected items. Renders a visual summary list of selected stems. Clicking 'Add Custom Bouquet to Cart' adds the completed custom item to the global cart.
edge_cases: Zero stems selected: The 'Add to Cart' button is disabled, showing a tooltip 'Please add at least one flower stem to your bouquet'.
Stem limit reached: Prevents adding more stems once the selected size limit is reached (e.g., 20 stems for Medium) and displays a friendly capacity warning.

features.name: Shopping Cart and Checkout Drawer
features.purpose: Enables users to review their selected items, specify delivery details, write a personalized card message, and complete their order.
features.interaction: User clicks the cart icon to open a sliding side drawer, adjusts item quantities, enters delivery address, selects a delivery date using a calendar picker, types a card message, and clicks 'Place Order'.
features.behavior: Updates quantities and totals in the cart state. On checkout submission, validates form fields, clears the cart state, closes the drawer, and opens an 'Order Confirmed' success dialog containing a mock order tracking number and selected delivery date.
edge_cases: Empty cart state: Displays 'Your cart is empty' with a 'Browse Arrangements' button that closes the drawer and scrolls to the catalog.
Invalid delivery date: Date picker restricts selections to today or future dates only; typing an past date triggers an inline validation error.
Missing card message: If empty, defaults to a standard 'A gift for you' message in the order payload.

features.name: Flower Care and Longevity Guide
features.purpose: Educates customers on how to prolong the life of their boutique arrangements, adding value and brand trust.
features.interaction: User clicks on interactive tabs corresponding to different flower types (e.g., 'Roses', 'Hydrangeas', 'Lilies').
features.behavior: Updates the active tab state and swaps the content panel to show specific watering, trimming, and sunlight placement tips for the selected flower category.
edge_cases: No tab selection: Defaults to displaying a general 'All Flowers' care guide upon initial load.

features.name: Arrangement Quick-View Modal
features.purpose: Allows users to view detailed descriptions, flower ingredients, and larger imagery of an arrangement without leaving the main catalog grid.
features.interaction: User clicks the 'Quick View' button overlay on any catalog item card.
features.behavior: Opens a centered modal overlay populating detailed product specifications, larger imagery, and a direct 'Add to Cart' button.
edge_cases: Pressing the 'Escape' key or clicking the backdrop overlay instantly closes the modal and returns focus to the clicked card.
